INSERT INTO notification (
            id,
            notification_event_type,
            event_item_id,
            event_item_type,
            service_sender,
            metadata
        )
        VALUES (
            $1,
            'channel_message_send',
            $2,
            'channel',
            'channels-test',
            jsonb_build_object('messageId', $3::text)
        )
